title: Lyrix Neural Network Application Schema
description: Defines the core metadata, ownership, and operational context for the Lyrix neural network application, developed for VersoriumX Technology, owned by Travis Jerome Goff.

application.description: Core details about the Lyrix application.

name.description: The formal name of the application.

version.description: The current version of this schema definition.

description.description: A brief overview of Lyrix's purpose and capabilities.
description.default: Lyrix is an open-source code engineering knowledge base and neural network application designed to assist with machine learning development and data analysis for VersoriumX.

namespace.description: The unique identifier namespace for the Lyrix application.

ownership.description: Ownership information for VersoriumX Technology and the Lyrix application.

company.description: The company associated with the technology.

owner.description: The individual owner of VersoriumX Technology and the Lyrix application.

contact_email.description: A contact email for ownership-related inquiries.

neural_network_details.description: Specifics regarding the neural network component integrated within Lyrix.

purpose.description: The primary function of the neural network within Lyrix.
purpose.default: Facilitates advanced data processing, pattern recognition, and predictive modeling based on user-selected data.

framework.description: The primary deep learning framework utilized by the neural network.

data_utilization.description: Describes how the neural network interacts with data.
data_utilization.default: The neural network leverages user-selected data for training, validation, and inference, with data sources managed via GCS buckets and Vertex AI Datasets.

gcs_integration.description: Details on Google Cloud Storage (GCS) usage for Lyrix's operations.

model_artifacts_bucket.description: The GCS bucket designated for storing trained models, checkpoints, and related artifacts.

data_library_bucket.description: The GCS bucket serving as the primary repository for user-selected data to inform and direct Lyrix's development.

default_storage_class.description: The default storage class configured for the primary GCS buckets.

vertex_ai_integration.description: Information regarding Lyrix's integration with Google Cloud Vertex AI.

api_endpoint_base.description: The base API endpoint for Vertex AI services used by Lyrix.

dataset_display_name.description: The display name of the Vertex AI Dataset used for Lyrix's data library.

postman_api_example.description: A Postman cURL command example for interacting with the Vertex AI API (e.g., listing models).
postman_api_example.default:
curl --location --request GET 'https://me-central1-aiplatform.googleapis.com/v1/projects/<YOUR_PROJECT_ID>/locations/us-central1/models' \
--header 'Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN>' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json'

# Note: Replace <YOUR_PROJECT_ID> with your actual GCP project ID.
# Replace <YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN> with a valid OAuth 2.0 access token (e.g., obtained via `gcloud auth print-access-token`).
